english.note: Use 會 as the all-purpose future auxiliary for future events or intentions.

Use 會 as the all-purpose choice for a future result viewed from the past, a conditional result, repeated past actions with a past-time context, advice in the pattern 如果我係你我會, and likely or expected outcomes.
Use 會 as the all-purpose way to express a future action in the first person.

examples.english: I will go to work earlier tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 zou2 di1 faan1 gung1

examples.english: Back then, I thought he would come, but he didn't.
examples.traditional: 嗰陣我估佢會嚟，但最後冇嚟。
examples.jyutping: go2 zan6 ngo5 gu2 keoi5 wui5 lei4 daan6 zeoi3 hau6 mou5 lei4

examples.english: We shall go on an outing tomorrow.
